name: continuity
description: Keep a long session's state across compaction: a PreCompact hook saves branch, diff, touched files and recent asks to a snapshot the post-compaction SessionStart restores, with the rules files on the cwd's walk re-inlined and the newest durable notes listed; a liveness line says when the save last worked; a context-pressure check asks for a handoff once before the window fills; and a handoff skill writes the judgment layer no hook can derive. Ships an OMP adapter that runs the same save and restore around an omp session's compactions.
